name: Verify LLM BLE action boundary: raw vs SDK typed on both platforms

text:
In this Flutter monorepo for smart glasses (WeiKe SDK), I'm evaluating the "SDK boundary" for the App LLM feature's device-BLE commands (domain 0x3C in `GlassesOrder`, `packages/common/common_ble_protocol/lib/src/protocol/glasses_order.dart`). A previous investigation found that iOS vendor source (`packages/core/core_device_native_runtime/ios/vendor/WeikeBLECore/Services/DeviceAudioStreamService.swift`) has typed methods (`sendWakeUpResult`, `sendLlmText`, `sendDeviceControl`, `sendTtsStatus`, etc.) that look like they mirror the raw 0x3C builders (`llmWakeResult`, `llmText`, `llmDeviceControl`, `llmTtsStatus`, `llmVad`, `llmRecordStatus`, `llmSearchStatus`, `llmExit`, `sendReminderFileStatus` in `glasses_order.dart`), but it's unclear whether this is actually the production path or just unused/parallel vendor source, and whether Android has an equivalent.

I need a precise, per-action verdict. Please investigate:

1. Read the full `DeviceAudioStreamService.swift` file (`packages/core/core_device_native_runtime/ios/vendor/WeikeBLECore/Services/DeviceAudioStreamService.swift`) and report every public method signature, what BLE frame/domain it appears to send (check comments/byte construction if visible), and whether it's referenced/called anywhere else in the vendored iOS source tree (grep for its class name and each method name across `packages/core/core_device_native_runtime/ios/vendor/`).

2. Check whether `core_device_native_runtime`'s actual Swift plugin implementation (non-vendor, i.e. `packages/core/core_device_native_runtime/ios/core_device_native_runtime/Sources/`) references `DeviceAudioStreamService` at all — grep for it. If unreferenced, that's strong evidence it's dead/unused vendor code, not a wired production path.

3. Read `native_app/inventory/06-app-llm-native-analysis.md` in full — this was cited as showing native apps use `AppLLMOrder` raw builders for LLM. Report exactly what `AppLLMOrder` is (native class, which platform(s), what it calls underneath — raw GATT write or a vendor SDK typed service), and whether the doc mentions `DeviceAudioStreamService` or an Android equivalent at all.

4. Search `native_app/docs/` and `native_app/inventory/` broadly (grep case-insensitive) for "DeviceAudioStreamService", "AudioStreamService", "sendWakeUpResult", "sendLlmText" to see if native docs describe this vendor service as production-adopted anywhere, on either iOS or Android.

5. Search for any Android equivalent: grep the Android AAR manifest/docs (`SDK/Android/`, `native_app/docs/02-SDK/`, `native_app/inventory/01-android-modules.md` if it exists) for any class/service name that looks like an LLM/audio-stream typed command builder analogous to iOS's `DeviceAudioStreamService`. Report what you find or confirm absence.

6. Read `packages/feature/ai/feature_app_llm/lib/src/controller/app_llm_fc_mapper.dart` and any other controller in `feature_app_llm` that calls `GlassesCommandSender`/`GlassesOrder` for the 0x3C domain — list each raw call site, and classify each as either (a) a pure "forward this event/status to the glasses over BLE with no other Flutter-side computation" action, or (b) an action that involves meaningful Flutter business logic (WSS parsing, FC mapping, state decisions) before constructing the frame.

7. Check `SDK/upgrade-requests.md` for the exact text of SDK-004 (or any LLM-specific line item) to see how precisely it's currently scoped, so I can tell whether it already captures a per-action LLM ask or is too coarse.

Report back with a clear verdict: is `DeviceAudioStreamService` a real, wired, production SDK typed path on iOS (with Android parity) that Flutter could migrate to today, or is it unused/orphaned vendor source that native apps themselves bypass in favor of raw frames? List the exact 0x3C actions in `GlassesOrder`/`feature_app_llm` with your (a)/(b) classification from point 6.
I'll trace the App LLM BLE command path end-to-end: vendor iOS service, plugin wiring, native docs, Android parity, and Flutter call sites.

## Executive verdict

**`DeviceAudioStreamService` is a real, published WeiKe SDK typed API** (same byte builders as `GlassesOrder` for domain `0x3C`), **but it is not a wired production path in this repo or in documented native-app behavior.** It is constructed on `WearfitBLESession.deviceAudioStream` and documented in Android SDK integration docs, yet has **zero call sites** anywhere in the vendored iOS tree or Flutter runtime plugin. Production native apps are documented to use **app-layer raw builders** (`AppLLMOrder` on Android, `sendLargeModel` on iOS howear).

**Android parity exists at the SDK documentation level** (`session.deviceAudioStream` with the same method names), but there is **no Android implementation source** in this repo and **no evidence native Wearfit Pro uses it** — only `AppLLMOrder`.

**Flutter cannot migrate to this typed path today** without new runtime bridging plus SDK-004 gating (per-protocol-family evidence, dual-platform verification). Current Flutter App LLM correctly owns raw `0x3C` frames via `GlassesCommandSender`.

---

## 1. `DeviceAudioStreamService.swift` — methods, frames, references

**File:** `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/core/core_device_native_runtime/ios/vendor/WeikeBLECore/Services/DeviceAudioStreamService.swift`

### Public API → BLE frame mapping

| Method | Frame / protocol | Maps to `GlassesOrder` |
|---|---|---|
| `init(rawDataStream:fileTrans:executor:)` | — | — |
| `observeStreams(autoRecordStatus:)` | Inbound `0xA2`/`0xA4` stream packets; may auto-send `0x3C/0x01`, `0x3C/0x02` | Partial (wake + record on setup/teardown) |
| `observeStreams(acceptedTypes:autoRecordStatus:)` | Same | Same |
| `observeAppLlmOpusAudio(autoRecordStatus:wakeUpResult:)` | Same, filtered to type `0x01` (App LLM Opus) | Same |
| `sendStreamCtrl(streamId:ctrl:)` / `sendStreamCtrl(streamId:ctrl: Int)` | **`0xA3` file-transport ctrl** via `fileTrans.write` — **not `0x3C`** | No `GlassesOrder` equivalent |
| `sendWakeUpResult(_:)` / `sendWakeUpResult(state:)` | `EA 00 04 00 3C 01 {state}` | `llmWakeResult` |
| `sendRecordStatus(isOpen:)` | `EA 00 04 00 3C 02 {0/1}` | `llmRecordStatus` |
| `sendVad()` | `EA 00 04 00 3C 05 01` (always active) | `llmVad(active: true)` only |
| `sendTtsStatus(playing:)` | `EA 00 04 00 3C 08 {1=playing, 2=stopped}` | `llmTtsStatus` |
| `sendLlmText(_:isUser:)` | `EA … 3C 06 {isUser} 00 {UTF-8}` | `llmText` |
| `sendLlmTextEnd(isUser:)` | `EA 00 05 00 3C 06 {isUser} 01` | `llmTextEnd` |
| `sendLlmError(errorCode:)` | `EA 00 04 00 3C 07 {code}` | `llmExit` |
| `sendDeviceControl(type:canContinue:)` | `EA 00 06 00 3C 04 {type_hi type_lo flag}` | `llmDeviceControl` |

**Not covered by `DeviceAudioStreamService`:**
- `0x3C/0x03` — `sendReminderFileStatus` (schedule audio xfer status)
- `0x3C/0x09` — `llmSearchStatus` (deep think)

### Reference grep across `ios/vendor/`

| Symbol | References outside defining file |
|---|---|
| Class `DeviceAudioStreamService` | **1** — only `WearfitBLESession.swift` (property + construction) |
| `.deviceAudioStream` (any call) | **0** — repo-wide, only assignment in `WearfitBLESession.swift:319` |
| `sendWakeUpResult`, `sendLlmText`, `sendTtsStatus`, `sendDeviceControl`, `sendVad`, `sendRecordStatus`, `observeAppLlmOpusAudio`, etc. | **0 external callers** — all references are internal to `DeviceAudioStreamService.swift` |

**Conclusion:** Even within vendored SDK source, this service is **instantiated but never invoked**.

---

## 2. Flutter plugin (non-vendor Swift) — references

Grep of `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/core/core_device_native_runtime/ios/core_device_native_runtime/Sources/`:

- **`DeviceAudioStreamService` — 0 matches**
- **`deviceAudioStream` — 0 matches**

The plugin uses `WearfitBLESession` for connect, settings, network, identity, etc., but **never touches the audio-stream service**. Strong evidence this is **not a wired production path in Flutter runtime**.

---

## 3. `06-app-llm-native-analysis.md` — what production native apps use

**File:** `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/inventory/06-app-llm-native-analysis.md`

### What `AppLLMOrder` is

- **Platform:** Android only (`module-ai/src/.../appllm/order/AppLLMOrder.kt`)
- **What it does:** App-layer BLE **raw frame builders** with methods `sendWakeUPResult`, `sendLLMText`, `sendVad`, `sendTtsStatus`, `sendDevCtrl`, etc.
- **What it calls underneath:** Documented as direct BLE send path, **not** `DeviceAudioStreamService`. The doc's Flutter target column maps it to `GlassesOrder.llm*`.

### iOS production send path

- **`WKDeviceLargeModel.swift` → `peripheral?.apps.streamDataApp.sendLargeModel(...)`** — legacy howear BLE helper, **not** `DeviceAudioStreamService`.

### Does the doc mention `DeviceAudioStreamService` or Android equivalent?

- **`DeviceAudioStreamService` — not mentioned**
- **`session.deviceAudioStream` — not mentioned**
- Android equivalent typed service — **not mentioned**; only `AppLLMOrder`

Architecture diagram shows `sendWakeUPResult(0)`, `BLE 0x3C/0x06`, `BLE 0x3C/0x08` as **raw domain/subId frames**, not SDK typed services.

---

## 4. Native docs/inventory grep

Case-insensitive search of `native_app/docs/` and `native_app/inventory/` for `DeviceAudioStreamService`, `AudioStreamService`, `sendWakeUpResult`, `sendLlmText`:

| Term | Hits |
|---|---|
| `DeviceAudioStreamService` | **0** |
| `AudioStreamService` | **0** |
| `sendWakeUpResult` / `sendWakeUPResult` | Only in `06-app-llm-native-analysis.md` (referring to **`AppLLMOrder.sendWakeUPResult`**) |
| `sendLlmText` | **0** |

**No native doc describes `DeviceAudioStreamService` as production-adopted on either platform.**

---

## 5. Android equivalent

### Found (SDK docs, not native-app source)

**File:** `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/SDK/Android/docs/sdk-integration-cn.md`

Documents `session.deviceAudioStream` with the same surface as iOS vendor source:

- **Observe:** `observeStreams(...)`, `observeAppLlmOpusAudio(...)`
- **Control:** `sendStreamCtrl`, `sendRecordStatus`, `sendWakeUpResult`, `sendVad`
- **LLM sync:** `sendTtsStatus`, `sendLlmText`, `sendLlmTextEnd`, `sendLlmError`, `sendDeviceControl`

Includes integration example wiring `deviceSession.deviceAudioStream.observeAppLlmOpusAudio()` → `llmSession.sendAudio(event.bytes)`.

Also documents **`weike-ai-capabilities`** → `WeikeAiCapabilities.appLlmConfig.fetchConfig(...)` + `createAppLlmSession()` for WSS — separate from BLE command sending.

### Not found

- No `DeviceAudioStream` references in `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/core/core_device_native_runtime/android/`
- No mention in `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/inventory/01-android-modules.md`
- No mention in `native_app/docs/02-SDK/`

**Verdict:** Android **SDK docs claim parity**, but **native Wearfit Pro inventory points to `AppLLMOrder` raw builders**, same bypass pattern as iOS howear.

---

## 6. Flutter `feature_app_llm` — all `0x3C` call sites and (a)/(b) classification

**Legend:**
- **(a)** Pure forward — event/status relay with minimal/no business logic before framing
- **(b)** Meaningful Flutter logic — state machine, WSS parsing, FC mapping, error decisions, etc.

All sends go through `glassesCommandSenderProvider` in `app_llm_controller.dart` unless noted.

### Per `GlassesOrder` builder

| Builder | subId | Call sites | Class |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`llmWakeResult(2)`** | 0x01 | `_handleWake` when already active / stopping | **(b)** busy guard |
| **`llmWakeResult(1)`** | 0x01 | Mic denied, config fail, engine fail, WSS fail | **(b)** error-path decisions |
| **`llmWakeResult(0)`** | 0x01 | `AppLlmSessionReadyEvent` | **(b)** gated on WSS session ready |
| **`llmRecordStatus`** | 0x02 | Engine start, speech started/stopped, TTS drain, barge-in, device/manual interrupt, FC resume, `_doStop` | **(b)** audio-phase state machine |
| **`llmVad`** | 0x05 | Speech started/stopped, TTS drain, interrupts, FC resume, `_doStop` | **(b)** audio-phase state machine |
| **`llmTtsStatus`** | 0x08 | Speech started, TTS playing, TTS drain, interrupts, FC resume, `_doStop` | **(b)** tied to WSS TTS events + phase |
| **`llmText` + `llmTextEnd`** | 0x06 | ASR final (user), LLM final (assistant), FC `FcOutcomeTts.bleText` | **(b)** WSS `isFinal` parsing; FC handler text generation |
| **`llmDeviceControl`** | 0x04 | `_handleFunctionCall` after `mapAppLlmFcToDeviceControl` | **(b)** FC name/args → type mapping; `canContinue` flag for battery |
| **`llmSearchStatus`** | 0x09 | `GlassesLlmDeepThinkEvent` listener | **(a)** relays device deep-think toggle back (value from device event) |
| **`sendReminderFileStatus`** | 0x03 | `app_llm_reminder_audio_service.dart` on file xfer start/success/fail | **(b)** TTS file gen + `DeviceFileTransferClient` lifecycle |
| **`llmExit`** | 0x07 | **Not called** in production `feature_app_llm` (only tests/docs) | N/A |

### Controllers involved

- **`app_llm_controller.dart`** — all runtime BLE sends above
- **`app_llm_fc_mapper.dart`** — maps FC → `llmDeviceControl*` type constants only (no direct send)
- **`app_llm_fc_handler.dart`** — business logic producing `bleText` / battery / music URL (send happens in controller)
- **`app_llm_reminder_audio_service.dart`** — `sendReminderFileStatus` only

**Summary:** Of active production actions, **only `llmSearchStatus` is (a)**. Everything else is **(b)**.

---

## 7. SDK-004 scope

**File:** `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/SDK/upgrade-requests.md`

**SDK-004 exact text (condensed):**

> **协议族迁移证据。** Flutter 当前仍拥有握手/身份、音乐 ACK、**LLM**、同传、位置/导航、健康和 OTA 协议流；`0035` 不将未文档化的 service 名称视为可迁移证据。
>
> **所需 SDK 交付：** 为**每个协议族**提供 Android/iOS 公开 API、支持设备/固件矩阵、请求/响应或完成语义、拒绝结果、超时、取消与断连行为。仅在无 typed service 的情况下提供字节/协议文档。
>
> **验收：** 只有在能实现并双端验证 typed 产品契约后，能力才迁入 `core_device_native_runtime`。在此之前 Flutter 所有权保持明确，禁止猜测映射或静默回退。
>
> **状态:** `awaiting_sdk_inventory`

**Assessment:** SDK-004 is **coarse-grained** — "LLM" is one protocol family alongside handshake, music ACK, interpretation, navigation, health, OTA. It does **not** break out per-action LLM asks (wake ack vs record status vs TTS vs FC device control vs reminder file status vs deep think). A per-action migration checklist would need a separate inventory under SDK-004.

---

## Bottom-line comparison

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Is `DeviceAudioStreamService` real SDK API? | **Yes** — vendor iOS source + Android SDK docs |
| Is it wired in production (native apps)? | **No evidence** — native apps use `AppLLMOrder` / `sendLargeModel` raw paths |
| Is it wired in Flutter runtime? | **No** — plugin never references it |
| Android parity? | **Documented** (`session.deviceAudioStream`); **not** shown in native-app inventory |
| Could Flutter migrate today? | **No** — needs runtime bridge + SDK-004 evidence; and most Flutter sends are **(b)** anyway (logic stays in Feature even if bytes move to SDK) |
| Typed service vs raw frames? | **Same bytes** — `DeviceAudioStreamService` is a thin wrapper over `BLECommandExecutor.execute` with identical `0xEA…0x3C` construction |

The typed service is **SDK-published infrastructure that native apps and Flutter both currently bypass** in favor of raw `0x3C` builders. It is **not orphaned dead code** (it's on the session object and documented), but it is **unreferenced in any production call chain present in this repo**.
